verdict.rationale: LocalAI is itself an API server: its docs describe an OpenAI-compatible REST API usable with any OpenAI SDK, plus the Anthropic Messages and Open Responses APIs. The repository ships a full Swagger 2.0 spec, and every server exposes an interactive Swagger UI and unauthenticated discovery endpoints, with per-user API keys for authenticated access. The website probes returning 404 for openapi.json do not contradict this, because the spec is served from the repo and the running server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the full API surface works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
The official mudler/LocalAI repository ships a full Swagger 2.0 specification of the REST API (info title "LocalAI API", description "The LocalAI Rest API.") at swagger/swagger.json
The full interactive API documentation is available without authentication at /swagger/index.html.
LocalAI also supports the **Anthropic Messages API**, the **Open Responses API**, and more.
Run with `LOCALAI_AUTH=true` for multi-user support with admin/user roles, OAuth login, per-user API keys, and usage tracking.
